lastCompletedStory.title: Re-anchor auto-ship to terminal complete+CLEAN with a persisted fire-once marker

nextStoryContext: US-001 moved autoShipFn from the review branch to the terminal 'complete' branch in loop.ts, gated on lastVerdict==='CLEAN' and a persisted fire-once marker (prd.review.autoShipDispatchedAt). The marker is written to prd.json via writePrd BEFORE dispatch. The old callsite (~line 1354 in the pre-US-001 loop.ts) is deleted. PrdSnapshot.review in decide.ts now carries autoShipDispatchedAt?: string. BUG A (operator story gates await-operator not complete) and BUG B (re-entry dedup) are covered by new tests in test/supervisor/auto-chain.test.ts. File-size budgets raised: decide.ts 155->159, loop.ts 1716->1731.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal TypeScript refactoring of loop.ts and decide.ts; no external library API exercised.
